evidence_form: Operator-relayed summary of the sanitized result: check statuses, C00 identity outcome and method, request counts and queue snapshots. The full result JSON was not provided to the repository.

source_contract.identity_method: SHA-256 of Function.prototype.toString of the executed production wrapper, compared in-browser with the 9cade1a body

passed_checks: C00 browser runs the production body of commit 9cade1a (MATCH_9CADE1A)
C01 qualified route: gelbooru.com image-post view with id
C02 production activates the gelbooru-family adapter on the post page
C03 production produces the Gelbooru minimal Post (GELBOORU_MINIMAL_POST)
C04 identity resolves from the native page id and agrees with the route
C05 site is gelbooru and media kind is image
C06 sample comes from the native img#image
C07 original comes from the native original link
C08 sample and original stay distinct when the page exposes distinct resources
C09 original is not fabricated from the sample
C10 original dimensions and score reach the Post from native statistics
C11 unobserved fields stay unknown: rating, byte size, md5, source, date, preview, tag arrays
C12 fail-closed video check does not disable the image path (no video element present)
C13 no enhancer request while producing the Post
C14 no enhancer request from postamble load through the observation window

request_observation.limitation: A request issued synchronously during production startup, before the postamble loaded, would not itself be counted. The zero queue and in-flight counts at postamble load show none was still pending then; they do not prove that no such request occurred.

prior_run: Package revision 1: C01-C14 PASS, C00 FAIL UNAVAILABLE (GM_info exposes no script source under Tampermonkey). Superseded by this run for C00; not used as the conformance result.
conclusion: Gelbooru live production conformance PASS(scope: logged-out native image post, production body 9cade1a). IB07 remains PARTIAL—NOT COMPLETE: §3 item 9 acceptance assertions are unresolved and the §3 item 10 naming-facts question is open.
